name: Overwritten Visual Effect
hint: The finder detects consecutive changes to the same visual state without a timed pause, including appearance, size, visibility, layer, speech, or graphic effects. The later block takes effect immediately, so the earlier visual state is not observable.
instruction: Pause between visual states when both should be seen, or remove or combine the earlier change when it has no intended visible effect.
